build.scope: Isolated hidden MFC manual-versus-resource construction prototype, 24 representative controls; no product changes or personal UI automation.

modes.1: Resource template plus second font assignment
modes.2: Manual creation without parent creation notifications
modes.3: Resource template reusing its assigned font

decision: No construction approach demonstrated a material gain in this prototype. Do not replace production File Info with a resource template or suppress parent notifications on this evidence.

report.scope: Hidden MFC prototype, 24 representative controls; not the actual File Info dialog, installed UDM or IDM.

modes.1: Resource template plus second font assignment
modes.2: Manual creation without parent creation notifications
modes.3: Resource template reusing its assigned font

helperValidation.context: Concurrent native menu-fixture compilation. Validation timings are retained but excluded from the construction architecture comparison.

limits: Hidden representative MFC controls; excludes actual UDM Form/ThemeCombo behavior, first paint, modal ownership and the real browser workload.
No installed-app or IDM speed measurement.
Matching font height, required styles, 24 direct controls, combo items/selection and hidden/disabled states were asserted; complete visual/tab/accessibility parity was not checked.
The resource-plus-second-font mode deliberately retains extra work; font reuse is measured separately.
Two earlier prototype attempts had an overly strict style assertion: Windows removes WS_VSCROLL from the outer combo. They are excluded from these successful samples.
No outlier was discarded from the measured rounds.
